items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know Baby Dodd said he worked a few nights at least in that band.

ctx.x: Do you remember many of the people from New Orleans that you worked with? I know Baby Dodd said he worked a few nights at least in that band. I think Zutty Singleton had too.
Zutty, I tried to get low at that time, but Lowey just about that time had made up his mind to organize his own band. And I had Freddie Keppert.
